Name: Furniture
Description: A sofa, a bed, an armchair — upholstery with air behind it. Acoustically the most useful thing in a room and the reason a furnished flat is not a reverberation chamber: carpet is a thin absorber and deaf to a long wavelength, but a padded seat with a cavity under it is a membrane absorber and takes the BASS out, which is the half a bare carpeted room keeps.
